## What it is

Using the [Star Dataset to Predict Star Types](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/deepu1109/star-dataset) available from Kaggle, we trained various machine models (e.g., kNN, tree classification, bagging, logistic regression) to predict star types. We presented our findings to the class and submitted a write up for our final.  

## What I did

- Compiled code from three other contributors into a single markdown.
- Wrote the introduction, conducted and reported the kNN analysis.
- Composed and formatted the final write up for the group.
